author: KEXP
description: In our latest in-studio session, composer Kalia Vandever brings their sonorous tone and lyrical voicing to the KEXP Live Room. With host DJ Kevin Sur, they deliver a performance of "Waiting" and more.
title: Kalia Vandever performs "Waiting" & more Live on KEXP
